title: Sri Lanka Family Circuit
headline: A fortress, a lake city, then a beach the children can use.
description: A six-night family circuit: Sigiriya and Kandy at an easy pace, then three nights on the south or west coast.
image_alt: Nine Arches Bridge and a train in the hills near Ella, Sri Lanka
price_label: Quoted for your family and dates
price_guidance: Family pricing depends on room type, child ages and beach town. Site tickets and any safari sit outside the base figure unless you ask us to include them.
overview: Culture first, beach second — short enough for school holidays. Pidurangala or a lower viewpoint can replace the full Sigiriya climb. Three coastal nights let everyone recover before the flight home.
highlights: Cultural-triangle stay with one fortress morning.
Kandy lake and the Temple of the Tooth.
Three nights on a family beach — Bentota or similar.
why: Three stays, not a hotel every night.
Climbs and site time can be cut for younger children.
The same driver stays with you on the circuit.
inclusions: Accommodation on twin or family-room sharing as quoted
exclusions: Site tickets, train seats and safari jeeps unless added
Personal expenses, GST and tourism fees

stay.name: Selected family-friendly hotels on a three-stop circuit
stay.room: Twin, double or interconnecting rooms as available

notes: Climb choice, beach town and any safari are confirmed in writing. Some sites close in heavy rain. An inquiry is not a booking.
itinerary_note: Suggested family order through Sigiriya, Kandy and the west or south coast. A cultural night can be dropped for more beach time.
